title: 第3章 走别人的路安全又实惠第4章 一步一个脚印
slug: 这个主角明明很强却异常谨慎
content_zh:
既是指定目标考核，那么选择路线便十分重要。
郑拓反手，从背包中取出一枚放大镜一样的东西。
这是他求一位修仙者特别给自己炼制的特殊放大镜。
功能与正常放大镜一样，只是可以自动调节放大强度。
最高级别能够达到显微镜的一百倍。
郑拓手持放大镜，一帧一帧在地面上寻找着什么。
不多时，终于发现目标。
那是一排排新鲜的脚印。
看上去有很多人向同一个方向出发，所以脚印十分杂乱无序。
沿着别人走过的路走，显然是最稳妥，最没有危险的方法。
走别人的路，让别人当自己的导盲犬，简直不要太舒服。
郑拓其实早有计划。
他的目标很简单，就是完好无损的完成考核，加入落仙宗。
至于其它，不在自己考虑范围内。
沿着脚印，一路前行，走了一天时间。
果真如他所猜想，跟着脚印走，没有遇到任何危险。
一路畅通，简直就像是在原始森林中旅游一样轻松。
话虽如此。
郑拓却并未有放松一丝一毫。
大腿上时刻贴着两张追风灵符，随时准备跑路。

精神高度集中，时刻警惕周围山林。
生怕突然窜出一头猛兽将自己干掉。
现在毕竟是考核期间，谨慎点总归没有错。
看看时间，日落东方，天色渐晚。
郑拓不得不停下脚步。
夜晚赶路本就危险，特别是在这种原始森林中，危险系数起码十个加号。
趁着天还没黑，先找一处隐蔽的安全屋在说。
轻车熟路，制作好安全屋。
随后，郑拓卸下背包。
背包不是普通的背包，是一种简陋的空间储存设备。
因为他不是修仙者，所以只能用这种简陋的储存设备。
不能如修仙者般，一枚小小的袋子，便能装有大量物品。
从背包中取出一百枚爆炸灵符，小心翼翼埋在附近。
一阶爆炸灵符，威力足以炸伤一阶炼气期修仙者。
属于普通人唯一能够使用的攻击型灵符。
content_en:
Since it is a designated target assessment, it is very important to choose the route.
Zheng Tuo turned around and took out something like a magnifying glass from his backpack.
This is a special magnifying glass that he asked a cultivator to refine for himself.
The function is the same as a normal magnifying glass, except that the magnification intensity can be automatically adjusted.
The highest level can reach a hundred times the power of a microscope.
Zheng Tuo held a magnifying glass and searched for something on the ground frame by frame.
After a while, the target was finally found.
It was a row of fresh footprints.
It looked like there were many people heading in the same direction, so the footprints were very messy.
Following the path that others have taken is obviously the safest and least dangerous way.
It's not very comfortable to follow someone else's path and let someone else be your guide dog.
Zheng Tuo actually had a plan.
His goal is simple, that is, to complete the assessment intact and join the Luo Xian Sect.
As for the others, they are beyond my consideration.
Following the footprints, we walked all the way for a day.
As he had guessed, he followed the footprints without encountering any danger.
The journey was smooth and it was as easy as traveling in a primeval forest.
Having said that.
Zheng Tuo did not relax at all.
There are two wind-chasing talismans always attached to his thighs, ready to run away at any time.
Be highly focused and always alert to the surrounding mountains and forests.
He was afraid that a beast would suddenly appear and kill him.
After all, this is the assessment period, so there is nothing wrong with being cautious.
Look at the time, the sun sets in the east, and it’s getting late.
Zheng Tuo had to stop.
Traveling at night is inherently dangerous, especially in this primitive forest. The risk factor is at least ten plus signs.
While it's still dark, let's find a secluded safe house.
Be familiar with the road and build a safe house.
Afterwards, Zheng Tuo took off his backpack.
A backpack is not an ordinary backpack, it is a simple space storage device.
Because he is not a cultivator, he can only use this crude storage device.
You can't be like the immortal cultivators who can hold a large number of items in a small bag.
He took out a hundred explosive charms from his backpack and carefully buried them nearby.
The first-level explosive talisman is powerful enough to injure a first-level Qi-refining stage cultivator.
It is the only offensive talisman that ordinary people can use.
